finding.statement: The normality hypothesis that FND-0132, FND-0144 and FND-0148 attach to the '[S_6:H] irreducible components of degree |H|' formula can be removed on the C66-GEO-COMP model, over a base S that is reduced and locally Noetherian but possibly non-normal and reducible, by counting at the generic point of each irreducible component rather than on the whole base. Concretely: let S_beta be an irreducible component of S with its reduced structure, eta its generic point, U_beta = U x_S S_beta and U_eta the generic fibre. Because U -> S is smooth with fibres open in P^2, U_beta is integral and U_eta is an OPEN SUBSCHEME OF P^2_{kappa(eta)}, hence normal and integral, with K(U_beta) = K(U_eta). Therefore Gal(K(U_beta)) surjects onto pi_1^et(U_eta), the number of field factors of the etale S_6-algebra Z_{K(U_beta)} equals [S_6 : H_gen] for H_gen the image of Gal(K(U_beta)) in S_6, and every irreducible component of the finite etale Z|_{U_beta} dominates U_beta (finite morphism, equidimensional of dim U_beta), so field factors correspond exactly to irreducible components. H_gen is then squeezed between the geometric monodromy of the geometric generic fibre U_{eta-bar} (computable by the single-fibre theorems, since kappa(eta)-bar is algebraically closed of characteristic zero) and any globally defined structure the family carries over S_beta.
